let scriptValue;
console.log(scriptValue);
function localRead() {
  let local;
  console.log(local);
  local = 4;
  console.log(local.toFixed());
}
function assignedByCallback() {
  let total;
  [1, 2, 3].forEach((value) => { total = value; });
  console.log(total);
}
function assignedByCall() {
  let value;
  const update = () => { value = 5; };
  update();
  console.log(value);
}
localRead();
assignedByCallback();
assignedByCall();
